en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground stands a plastered church with a steep gabled roof and a squat onion‑domed tower. Around it are compact townhouses with steep roofs, while further up the wooded hillside are several freestanding villas and larger houses in late‑19th‑century style. Paths and terraces cut through the forested slope, and the distant background shows rolling hills and farmland.
